sections.label: Cleaning workforce professionalisation strategies
sections.summary: The Environmental Services Industry Transformation Map develops strategies to professionalise the cleaning workforce through technology, upskilling and procurement practices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Under the Environmental Services Industry Transformation Map, strategies and initiatives have been developed to professionalise the cleaning workforce through the adoption of technology, upskilling of cleaners and improving procurement practices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: These will help to build a professional, skilled and manpower-lean cleaning workforce and drive the adoption of good practices within the industry.

sections.label: Considering non-compliance informants
sections.summary: NEA, the Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment and the Ministry of Manpower will consider anyone who informs them about non-compliance and conduct enforcement checks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The short answer to his question is yes, we will consider anyone who informs us about non-compliance.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: NEA and the Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment, together with the Ministry of Manpower, will conduct enforcement checks.
